title: Independent render visibility plans
description: Camera, reflection and light projections own separate cause-driven plans. GPU-owned instances stay outside CPU camera/reflection candidates; stationary shadow eligibility and models remain resident.
programProvenance: Baseline dist was rebuilt before renderer edits; the changed renderer was rebuilt before the after measurements. Unmodified reruns retain identical recorded source/dist fingerprints. HEAD alone does not describe these uncommitted working-tree builds.
methodology: Three sequential before repetitions, then three after repetitions. Same native GPU, controls, compiled fixture, physics and pixels. GPU clock/load can vary; headless RAF is not a display/VSync measurement.
pixelsInspectedPerView: Wet fixture: all RGBA8 presentation and all finite rgba16float reflection texels, exact gate. Benchmark: all decoded PNG channels must be within the observed before-run repeat range at that pixel/channel, without a fixed tolerance.

unmodifiedRepeat.limitation: Unmodified builds vary at the reported RGB8 channels. The internal GPU/capture cause is not isolated. These observations are retained; failed gates remain failed.

visibilityPlanGate: Each fresh fixture owns count+9 entries. Static light projection builds exactly once, performs count+1 tests total and zero on the last measured frame; CPU camera/reflection each own one static candidate, plus movers. All 12 measured cases must satisfy this.
